leads.title: Caribbean Territories (Criminal Law) Order, 2000
leads.documents: Express decriminalisation of same-sex sexual acts in Cayman Islands; legal status baseline
leads.detail: Cited as Britain's Order taking effect 1 January 2001; no URL shown in article text

leads.title: Marriage Law of the Cayman Islands
leads.documents: Defines marriage as between one man and one woman; ban on same-sex marriage
leads.detail: Cited as defining marriage as opposite-sex only; no URL shown

leads.title: Constitution of the Cayman Islands
leads.documents: Notes right of opposite-sex couples to marry, does not explicitly mention same-sex unions; guarantees equality/non-discrimination but 2009 draft excluded LGBT rights
leads.detail: Cited re opposite-sex marriage right and secular equality guarantee; no URL shown

leads.title: Immigration Appeals Tribunal Ruling - July 2016
leads.documents: Granted immigration dependency rights to same-sex spouse; shows immigration rights machinery
leads.detail: Ruled in favour of gay man seeking to be added to spouse's work permit as dependent; no URL shown

leads.title: Grand Court Ruling - Day and Bodden v Government, 29 March 2019 by Chief Justice Anthony Smellie
leads.documents: Declared same-sex marriage ban unconstitutional; key marriage-equality ruling later stayed
leads.detail: Lawsuit lodged June 2018 by Chantelle Day and Vickie Bodden, oral arguments February 2019, decision 29 March 2019; no URL shown

leads.title: Cayman Islands Court of Appeal Judgment - 7 November 2019
leads.documents: Overturned Grand Court, upheld ban but ordered government to implement civil unions or equivalent and ordered UK to intervene if failed
leads.detail: Arguments heard 3 days starting 28 August 2019, decision 7 November 2019; no URL shown

leads.title: Civil Partnership Law, 2020 and 11 consequential laws
leads.documents: Creates civil partnerships for same-sex and opposite-sex couples with health insurance, immigration and marital rights
leads.detail: Domestic partnership bill introduced 26 June 2020 failed 8-9; Governor Martyn Roper assented 4 September 2020 effective same day; upheld by Privy Council in 2025; no URL shown

leads.title: UK Privy Council / London court decision - March 2022
leads.documents: Final appeal upholding legal ban on same-sex marriage in Cayman Islands
leads.detail: Appeal by Day/Bodden, oral arguments set 23 February 2021, London court upheld ban March 2022; no URL shown

leads.title: British Foreign Affairs Committee report on 2009 draft constitution
leads.documents: Human-rights machinery finding that exclusion of sexual orientation as prohibited discrimination ground breaches rights
leads.detail: Described exclusion as 'deplorable', raised concern of less than full protection under European Convention on Human Rights; no URL shown

leads.title: Cayman Government enforcement incidents - 1998 Tourism Ministry cruise ban and 2008 police arrest
leads.documents: 1998 forbidding of Norwegian Cruise Line ship with 900+ gay travellers from porting; 2008 arrest of Massachusetts gay man for kissing partner on nightclub dancefloor; shows enforcement/hostility history
leads.detail: Tourism Ministry quote: 'We cannot count on this group to uphold the standards of appropriate behaviour expected of visitors'; 2008 arrestee later released; no URL shown
